female.look: A sharp-eyed young mouse in a travel cloak, whiskers white at the tips.
female.examine: She is a mouse, quick and sure-footed, cloak pinned with a wooden clasp. Ink stains her paws. She looks ready to run a message, not to be tucked into a pocket.

male.look: A sharp-eyed young mouse in a patched jacket, whiskers white at the tips.
male.examine: He is a mouse in a patched jacket, ears up, a scrap of map in one pocket. His whiskers twitch at new footsteps, and he already measures the exits.

female.look: A long-legged young hare in a travel cloak, ears ink-tipped.
female.examine: She is a hare, tall for a first-year, cloak still dusty from the road. A braided cord holds a wooden token at her throat. She looks as if she could cover the orchard in three bounds.

male.look: A long-legged young hare in a travel cloak, ears ink-tipped.
male.examine: He is a hare, restless and road-ready, ears ink-tipped, cloak still creased from packing. A braided cord holds a wooden token at his throat.

female.look: A young badger in academy grey, stripe bright as chalk, built to hold a door.
female.examine: She is a badger, solid as a doorpost, stripe bright as chalk. Academy grey sits well on her shoulders. Her claws are clean, and they are not for show.

male.look: A young badger in academy grey, stripe bright as chalk, built to hold a door.
male.examine: He is a badger, heavy-shouldered, stripe bright as chalk. Academy grey sits well on him. He looks as if he would rather be useful than praised.

female.look: A river-sleek young otter with wet-dark fur and a moss-green scarf.
female.examine: She is an otter, fur dark as river water, scarf knotted once and tight. Her whiskers are bright. She smells of reed and lamp oil, and she looks ready to dive or climb.

male.look: A river-sleek young otter with wet-dark fur and a moss-green scarf.
male.examine: He is an otter, fur dark as river water, scarf knotted once. His paws look ready to climb or swim at the first excuse, and he does not wait to be asked twice.

female.look: A red squirrel with a banner-tail and a worn satchel at her hip.
female.examine: She is a squirrel, tail full as a banner, satchel bumping her hip. Nut shells and a stub of chalk share a pocket. She keeps glancing at the rafters as if the floor were only a suggestion.

male.look: A red squirrel with a banner-tail and a worn satchel at his hip.
male.examine: He is a squirrel, tail full as a banner, satchel bumping his hip. He watches the beams first and the conversation second.

female.look: A young mole in earth-brown velveteen, digging paws folded but ready.
female.examine: She is a mole in earth-brown velveteen, eyes kind and a little short-sighted. Her paws are large. She speaks as if every word should be placed, then held.

male.look: A young mole in earth-brown velveteen, digging paws folded but ready.
male.examine: He is a mole in earth-brown velveteen, eyes kind and a little short-sighted. His paws are large, and he smells of damp soil and warm bread.

female.look: A young hedgehog with combed quills and a tightly buttoned waistcoat.
female.examine: She is a hedgehog, quills combed as well as quills allow, waistcoat buttoned one too high. A brass lantern pin sits on her lapel. She looks determined to get the rules right.

male.look: A young hedgehog with combed quills and a tightly buttoned waistcoat.
male.examine: He is a hedgehog, quills combed as well as quills allow, waistcoat buttoned one too high. A brass lantern pin sits on his lapel.

female.look: A young fox in russet, brush neat, eyes sharp as needles.
female.examine: She is a fox, russet coat brushed, white bib clean. Her eyes miss little. A thin silver chain holds a leaf-shaped charm, and she does not waste a smile.

male.look: A young fox in russet, brush neat, eyes sharp as needles.
male.examine: He is a fox, russet coat brushed, white bib clean. His eyes miss little. A thin silver chain holds a leaf-shaped charm.

female.look: A slim young stoat in a dark jerkin, tail tipped in black.
female.examine: She is a stoat, slim and quick, jerkin dark, tail black-tipped. She stands as if she might dart, then remembers she is meant to be still.

male.look: A slim young stoat in a dark jerkin, tail tipped in black.
male.examine: He is a stoat, slim and quick, jerkin dark, tail black-tipped. He stands as if he might dart, then remembers he is meant to be still.

female.look: A young barn owl with a heart-shaped face and a scholar's ribbon.
female.examine: She is an owl, face pale as parchment, a scholar's ribbon on one talon. She blinks slowly, as if the room were a page she has not finished, and she will not be hurried.

male.look: A young barn owl with a heart-shaped face and a scholar's ribbon.
male.examine: He is an owl, face pale as parchment, a scholar's ribbon on one talon. He blinks slowly, as if the room were a page he has not finished.

female.look: A stout young toad in a damp waistcoat, gold spectacles low.
female.examine: She is a toad, stout and gleaming, waistcoat a little damp, gold spectacles low on her snout. She smells of pondweed and peppermint, and she does not startle easily.

male.look: A stout young toad in a damp waistcoat, gold spectacles low.
male.examine: He is a toad, stout and gleaming, waistcoat a little damp, gold spectacles low on his snout. He smells of pondweed and peppermint.
